text.aria-label: Title text 'Figure 11: The hindsight Kalman filter did not beat the causal one, and the gap shrank from 0.42 to 0.03 points without two plant-months'
text.tspan: Figure 11: The hindsight Kalman filter did not beat the causal one, and
the gap shrank from 0.42 to 0.03 points without two plant-months

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Change in an XGBoost forecast's mean absolute error. The hindsight Kalman filter also reads the weeks after the day it estimates; the causal one reads only the days before. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months. Rows 1 and 2 are against B0 (orange). Rows 3 and 4 are hindsight minus causal (blue), the second without the two plant-months with the largest gap. Exploratory and post hoc.'
text.tspan: Change in an XGBoost forecast's mean absolute error. The hindsight Kalman filter also reads the weeks after the day
